summary: Deck search primitive (#312: Ikoma Shizuka, Imperial Gift) plus the look-at-the-top-N primitive (#322, merged in from #329: Public Records, Isawa Tamaki, Bayushi Kahoku exp2, Banish All Doubt, Signs and Portents), with origin/main (aa42e153: Kahoku exp / personality-wave-24 #316, pile targets #319, hand-played Attack discard #325) merged in. Conflicts resolved keeping both sides: AbilityDefinition carries main's IfTarget/TargetMustBe/FollowerException and this branch's Search/Look (appended; every caller uses named arguments), personality-wave-24 registered ahead of this branch's waves and now also guarded against duplicates by them, csproj and CardCatalog carry every wave, the inventory workbook regenerated (403 wired). Pinned published count re-derived at 403 = 396 on origin/main + 7 (Imperial Gift, Ikoma Shizuka, Signs and Portents, Isawa Tamaki, Kahoku exp2, Banish All Doubt, Public Records), counted from the JSON files.
validation: bash tools/check.sh (full, Godot import and smoke included) passed on the merged tree: 209 core, 57 published, 18 gold-parity, 20 gold-quote, 9 deck-format, 10 deck-workshop, 22 deck-search, 14 deck-look, 21 ai, 8 server, 7 client transport, python content tests. Mutations re-run on the merged tree and caught: look view visible to the opponent (3 deck-look failures), generator state not persisted after a shuffle (2 deck-search failures), an extra draw in the setup shuffles (SetupShufflesUnchanged fails). No test needed a semantic change. The first Godot import in a fresh worktree printed one get_multiple_md5 null-file error on a table-art texture (asset cache warmup, unrelated to this change); the rerun was clean.
remaining: Client UI for the deck viewer and the look arrangement (#314, #315, #323, Alfredo). Rules questions awaiting Mendon are in docs/decisions/2026-09-18-deck-search-primitive.md and 2026-09-18-look-top-cards-primitive.md. #324 and #327 touch overlapping files (Models.cs, MatchQueries.cs, MatchEngine.cs, CardAbilities.cs, MatchSession.cs): whichever merges first needs one more merge of main and a re-derived pinned count.
